recipe.label: FIGARO E3 2015 sut
recipe.attribution: Credit the European Commission JRC and the dataset authors; indicate changes. FIGARO E3 retains its own source terms.
recipe.ghg_note: Source-characterised AR5 GWP100 CO2eq (CO2, CH4, N2O and F-gases). The parser-specific isolated Irish paper-incineration loop correction retains original production accounts; its unallocable emissions stay by production origin, without consumer allocation.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. Source-characterised AR5 GWP100 CO2eq (CO2, CH4, N2O and F-gases). The parser-specific isolated Irish paper-incineration loop correction retains original production accounts; its unallocable emissions stay by production origin, without consumer allocation. Unallocated production emissions: 162,293,825.293 t CO2eq globally; direct unrepresented accounts and requirements outside observed final demand are retained by production origin, without a consumer allocation.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed. Unallocated production value added: 10,466,382.684 EUR globally (signed native-currency result). Direct unrepresented production accounts and upstream requirements outside observed final demand stay by production origin.
